Mac mini M4 原创麦金塔复古机箱（兼容 9.7/10.2 寸 iPad和同尺寸便携屏）
自己建模原创设计的 Mac mini M4 复古机箱，致敬初代 Macintosh。历经三个版本迭代，解决了散热差、接口难插、线材凌乱的痛点。
双尺寸兼容： 两款支架设计。不论是老款 iPad (4/5/6/Air/Pro 9.7) 还是新款 (7/8/9代 10.2寸)，或者是 DIY 的同尺寸便携屏，都能完美固定。
6风扇散热： 内部集成 6 风扇控温系统，针对 M4 底部进风、环形出风的逻辑专门优化，高负载运行不降频。（风扇购买3.5cmx3.5cm）  
线材全隐藏： 中层放主机，底座是线材收纳舱。所有接线内部消化，桌面只露出电源线和网线，极其整洁。
榫卯结构： 全机三层榫卯咬合，不需要一滴胶水，方便随时拆卸升级或维护硬件。
正面接口： 底座正面自带 Type-C 接口，插 U 盘或接外设不用去背后摸索。

 

开关:独特设计得机箱外部机械开关，开关机不用再专门打开机器，可以直接在机器背部控制 
【可选配置】
背出线版： 追求极致性价比，直接露出 Mac 接口使用，省去多余线材钱。
全隐藏版： 带独立电源开关，将电源，网口集成在背面，观感最统一，也最像一体式电脑
【材质与颜色】
复古暖黄 (PLA)：还原白色外壳经过时间氧化后的 经典麦金塔质感。
纯白色 (PETG)： 耐温性更好，还原新机感觉。
最大支持便携屏外壳尺寸:长 240mm / 高 180mm / 厚 20mm。
整机尺寸长288mm宽255mm高330mm
底部配有 2cm 厚 TPU 减震脚垫，吸气顺畅且防滑。

### Original Macintosh-Style Retro Case for Mac mini M4

Compatible with 9.7-inch and 10.2-inch iPads and similarly sized portable monitors

This is an original Mac mini M4 retro case designed and modeled by myself, inspired by the original Macintosh.

After three major design revisions, the case now addresses common issues such as poor cooling, difficult access to ports, and messy cable management.

### Dual-Size Compatibility

Two different screen mounting brackets are included.

The case supports:

* Older 9.7-inch iPads, including iPad 4/5/6, iPad Air, and iPad Pro 9.7
* 10.2-inch iPads, including iPad 7th/8th/9th generation
* DIY portable monitors of a similar size
Both 9.7-inch and 10.2-inch screens can be securely mounted.

### Six-Fan Cooling System

The case supports an integrated six-fan cooling system.

The internal airflow has been specially optimized for the Mac mini M4’s bottom air intake and circular exhaust design, helping prevent thermal throttling during high-load operation.

Recommended fan size: 35 mm × 35 mm.

### Fully Hidden Cable Management

The Mac mini is installed in the middle compartment, while the bottom section functions as a dedicated cable-management chamber.

All cables and adapters can be hidden inside the case. Only the power cable and Ethernet cable need to remain visible on the desk, creating a clean and tidy setup.

### Mortise-and-Tenon Assembly

The entire case consists of three interlocking layers.

No glue is required, making the case easy to disassemble for future upgrades, maintenance, or hardware replacement.

### Front USB-C Port

A USB Type-C port is integrated into the front of the base.

This makes it easy to connect USB drives and other accessories without reaching around to the back of the computer.

### External Mechanical Power Switch

The case features a specially designed external mechanical power switch.

You can turn the Mac mini on or off directly from the rear of the case without opening or removing the computer.

### Optional Versions

### Rear-Port Version

Designed for maximum value and simplicity.

The Mac mini’s original ports remain exposed and can be used directly, reducing the need for additional extension cables and adapters.

### Fully Hidden Version

Includes an independent power switch, with the power connection and Ethernet port integrated into the rear panel.

This version provides the cleanest appearance and makes the system look more like a true all-in-one computer.

### Materials and Colors

### Retro Warm Yellow — PLA

Designed to recreate the classic appearance of an original white Macintosh enclosure that has naturally yellowed over time.

### Pure White — PETG

Provides better heat resistance and recreates the appearance of a brand-new Macintosh-style computer.

### Maximum Supported Portable Monitor Size

* Width: 240 mm
* Height: 180 mm
* Thickness: 20 mm

### Overall Case Dimensions

* Length: 288 mm
* Width: 255 mm
* Height: 330 mm
The bottom is fitted with 20 mm-thick TPU shock-absorbing feet, allowing sufficient airflow underneath while also improving grip and reducing vibration.

### Notes

### 1. Screen Compatibility

You can install either an iPad or a portable monitor directly into the case.

Both 9.7-inch and 10.2-inch screens are supported.
